profile.visual_desc: Muscular blue-scaled dragonoid with large bat-like wings and a thick tail. Wears grey plate armor with distinct orange tiger-stripe patterns.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Blue reptilian profile with sharp teeth and a glowing blue eye. Features jagged horns and dark navy scales.
profile.weapon_desc: Heavy curved silver falchion held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Holds blade upright with wings partially folded and tail resting.
profile.step2_windup: Crouches and leaps upward, hoisting the sword high above the head while wings spread wide.
profile.step3_impact: Swings downward toward the upper-left, creating a large, bright yellow crescent energy arc following the blade's path.
profile.step4_finish: Lands in a braced stance as the golden energy trail fades and wings begin to retract.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The yellow energy arc in Frame 4 must follow the diagonal downward trajectory of the sword swing toward the top-left.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation effectively interpolates reference frames. Biomechanics and VFX alignment remain consistent throughout the sequence.
